name: distressor-aggressive-drums
description: The iconic forward/aggressive UADx Distressor drum sound: Ratio 10:1 (the famous 'British'-style Distressor drum ratio), input 8 for real gain reduction, attack 4 (medium-fast — grabs the transient for that smacked density), release 2 (fast = aggressive, dense, the Distressor 'attitude'), AUDIO = Dist 2 warmth, DETECTOR = HP so the kick still punches. Denser and more in-your-face than distressor-drum-glue. Great on a drum bus, snare bus, or room you want forward.
intended_for: a drum bus / snare / room that should sound aggressive, dense and forward (not transparent)
plugin_build: uaudio_distressor.vst3 (UADx native build — RENDERS headless & processes offline, verified changed:true; do not use the /Components/UAD Empirical Labs Distressor.component twin — passthrough offline).
notes: 10:1 is the Distressor's signature aggressive ratio — fast, hard, but program-dependent. Higher ratios (20:1, NUKE) clamp harder; NUKE is a saturated near-brickwall.

attack 4 + release 2 = the dense/aggressive voicing (fast release pumps the level back up between hits). Slow the attack toward 6-7 if it kills the punch too much, or raise mix below 100 for parallel.
DETECTOR HP keeps the kick out of the detector so it punches through the density. Try Emp instead to make the detector grab the snare/cymbals harder.
ratio/detector/audio are STRING enums -> preset harness only (apply-vst-chain can't pass them).
It compresses hard AND adds harmonics -> A/B loudness-matched; judge by feel, not level.
